summary: RAG few-shot + retrieved coverage checklist, single call
hypothesis: Injecting a task-conditioned coverage checklist — dimensions aggregated from the same nearest exemplars used for RAG — should beat a universal checklist by giving the model decision-critical dimension labels tailored to the specific task, nudging it toward the right coverage axes.
technique: At runtime, retrieve the 2 nearest gold exemplars (same as exp003), aggregate their tagged decision-critical dimension labels into a coverage checklist, and inject both the exemplars and the checklist into a single on-device generation call — no separate auditor or post-processing pass.

stages.text: Fetch 2 nearest gold exemplars + dimension labels
Single call: RAG few-shot + coverage checklist injected
